_comment_connection: Create a Fabric SharePoint Online connection in the workspace and paste its GUID here. Leave blank to deploy the inventory pipeline as a skeleton (the rest of the stack still deploys).
_comment_graph: Service principal used by the Spark notebook to read SharePoint via Microsoft Graph (Sites.Read.All / Files.Read.All). The secret is read from Key Vault at run time; never store it here.
_comment_sites: Document libraries to migrate. The master pipeline runs once per entry (SiteUrl/LibraryName/Mode).
